body:
**Blocked by #167.** This is the template slice — slices 5-9 copy its shape.

### Change

- Move `src/app/(dashboard)/settings/audit-logs/page.tsx` to `src/app/(dashboard)/system/audit-logs/page.tsx`.
- Create `src/app/(dashboard)/system/layout.tsx`. The System section needs no in-page sidebar; add its pages as `children` of the existing `system` section in `src/config/navigation.ts`, following the `NAV_BILLING` / `NAV_PAYMENTS` pattern.
- Replace the old page with `redirect('/system/audit-logs')` — the repo already does this at `settings/user-roles/page.tsx`.
- Remove the entry from the Access & Security group in `src/config/settings-nav.ts`.
- Update hardcoded links: `src/components/dashboard/recent-activity-card.tsx:203` and `src/components/dashboard/modern-recent-activity.tsx:154`.

### ROUTE_PERMISSIONS — get this exactly right

**Keep** `'/settings/audit-logs': [SETTINGS_VIEW_AUDIT_LOGS]` and **add** `'/system/audit-logs': [SETTINGS_VIEW_AUDIT_LOGS]`.

The redirect stub is a page component, so it runs after middleware. Deleting the old entry does not clean up — it widens who reaches the stub to anyone satisfying the generic `/settings` fallback. And a missing new entry makes the page public (see #167).

### Also required in this slice

**Add a `/system` sibling of `src/__tests__/settings-nav-coverage.test.ts`.** That test hardcodes `settingsDir` to the settings directory and will not cover the new tree. Without it, every later slice can ship a page with no route guard and nothing will fail.

### Docs

Update source globs and content in `website/docs/settings/access-and-system-health.md`, then run `npm run docs:verify` against it.

### Verify

`npm test`; `npm run build`; click through from the dashboard Recent Activity card.
